provenance.authorship: Original AI-assisted practice prompts and explanations based on factual official guidance; not copied official examination questions.
provenance.source_check_description: Answers were drafted and checked against retrieved official-page text. Some Ontario origin pages denied direct access, so their indexed official text was used. Retrieval does not establish a legal effective date or independent instructor approval.

usage.notice: Do not publish this draft as verified, official, complete, licensed or guaranteed-pass material. All records require independent review and documented rights clearance before public distribution.

coverage.concept_pairing: Each concept has one knowledge and one application variant. Select at most one variant of a concept per assessment. There are 500 prompts, not 500 unrelated facts or 200 unique sign illustrations.
known_gaps: Accurate, rights-cleared visual road-sign assets and image-recognition testing.
Independent Ontario content review, including plausible distractors, exceptions and source disagreements.
Detailed child-seat and booster thresholds, collision-reporting thresholds, demerit schedules and newly changing sanctions require a separate current-source expansion.
Country-pack exam format and pass rules require authority verification before mock-exam release.
claims_to_avoid: Independently verified when only AI/source checks exist

timing.note: DriveTest describes the knowledge test as not timed; office-closing constraints still apply.

This package does not assert that those settings were independently confirmed from the retrieved test-provider page. Validate them before calling a session an official-format simulation.

Independent reviewer other than the author approves each exact revision.
Rights/permissions basis documented for questions and any media.
Approved authoritative exam template; visual-sign coverage where advertised.
Immutable revision and release manifest; signed delivery built and audited.
